== Overview ==

This page describes the custom extensions/modifications made to [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/SecureConnectionProtocol|SecureConnectionProtocol]] by Nintendo Badge Arcade.

== Methods ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Method ID !! Name
|-
| 9 || [[#GetMaintenanceStatus]]
|}

=== GetMaintenanceStatus ===

Checks the server maintenance status of the game server. This data is handled identically to how the game server maintenance notifications are handled in [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/NotificationProtocol|NotificationProtocol]].

==== Request ====

This method does not take any parameters.

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| UInt16 || maintenanceStatus || Maintenance notification category ID. Either <code>GameServerMaintenance</code> or <code>MaintenanceAnnouncement</code>, or if there is no maintenance <code>0xFFFF</code>
|-
| UInt32 || maintenanceTime || UNIX timestamp (not a [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#DateTime|DateTime]]) for when the maintenance period begins, if the status is <code>MaintenanceAnnouncement</code>
|-
| Boolean || isSuccess || Unknown
|}
